label: Predict Structure - Esmfold Mode
description: Parameters for esmfold mode. Load this when the user selects tool=esmfold.

parameters.label: Prediction Tool
parameters.desc: Structure prediction engine. 'auto' picks Boltz (highest quality) by default; MSA fetched via ColabFold server automatically.

parameters.label: Protein FASTA
parameters.desc: Protein sequence(s) in FASTA format. Multi-chain complexes: include multiple sequences in one file.

parameters.label: Job Name
parameters.desc: Output name. Results land at output_path/.output_file/ in the workspace.

parameters.label: Output Format
parameters.desc: Primary structure output format. Both PDB and mmCIF are always generated.

parameters.label: Half-Precision (FP16)
parameters.desc: Use FP16 inference to reduce memory and increase speed.

parameters.label: Chunk Size
parameters.desc: Chunk size for long sequences. Smaller values reduce GPU memory.

parameters.label: Max Tokens per Batch
parameters.desc: Maximum tokens per batch for multi-sequence input.
